name: Shutter Miscalibration Correction
definition: A learned per-color-channel scaling technique to account for miscalibration when using variable exposure inputs, where brightness decays at different rates per color channel for faster shutter speeds.
summary: Shutter Miscalibration Correction is a training-time technique that applies learned, per-channel scaling factors to compensate for sensor-specific color mismatches caused by varying shutter speeds.
